verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡(ኪንሰ፡)ለዘ፡ አስተሐመመ፡ በልቡ፡(ውእቱ፡)ወዘይኄሊ፡ ሕጎ፡ ለልዑል፡ ጥበብ(ሰ)፡ ተኀሠት፡ በኀበ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ቀደምት፡ ወትሜህር፡ ተነብዮተ፡ ለዕደው።
verses.translation: will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients, and be occupied in prophecies.

translations.lxx: will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients, and be occupied in prophecies.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea tuturor celor de demult o va cerceta înţeleptul şi în proorocii se va îndeletnici.
translations.grk: σοφίαν πάντων ἀρχαίων ἐκζητήσει, καὶ ἐν προφητείαις ἀσχοληθήσεται.

verses.geez: እለ፡ አስመዩ፡ በሃይማኖት፡ ወታበውእ፡ ውስተ፡ አምሳለ፡ ነቢያት።
verses.translation: He will keep the sayings of the renowned men: and where subtil parables are, he will be there also.

translations.lxx: He will keep the sayings of the renowned men: and where subtil parables are, he will be there also.
translations.ron: Graiurile bărbaţilor celor vestiţi le va păzi şi va străbate cuvintele cele pline de tâlc.
translations.grk: Διηγήσεις ἀνδρῶν ὀνομαστῶν συντηρήσει, καὶ ἐν στροφαῖς παραβολῶν συνεισελεύσεται.

verses.geez: ወተኅሥሥ፡ አምሳለ፡ ዘኅቡእ፤[ወትትመየጥ]፡ በፍካሬ፡ አምሳል።
verses.translation: He will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, and be conversant in dark parables.

translations.lxx: He will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, and be conversant in dark parables.
translations.ron: Înţelesul ascuns al pildelor îl va căuta şi în tainele proverbelor va pătrunde.
translations.grk: Ἀπόκρυφα παροιμιῶν ἐκζητήσει, καὶ ἐν αἰνίγμασι παραβολῶν ἀναστραφήσεται.

verses.geez: ወትበቊዕ፡ በማእከለ፡ መኳንንት፡ ወታስተርኢ፡ በማእከለ፡ መላእክት፡ ወትበውእ፡ ብሔረ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ነኪር፡ እስመ፡ ወጠንቆሙ፡ ለእጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ በሠናይትኒ፡ ወበእኪትኒ።
verses.translation: He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries; for he hath tried the good and the evil among men.

translations.lxx: He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries; for he hath tried the good and the evil among men.
translations.ron: În mijlocul celor mari va sluji şi înaintea povăţuitorilor se va arăta.
translations.grk: Ἀναμέσον μεγιστάνων ὑπηρετήσει, καὶ ἔναντι ἡγουμένου ὀφθήσεται· ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίων ἐθνῶν διελεύσεται, ἀγαθὰ γὰρ καὶ κακὰ ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐπείρασε.

verses.geez: ወሜጠ፡ ልቦ፡ ከመ፡ ይጊሥ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈጣሪሁ፤ወ(ከመ፡)፡ ይጼሊ፡ ቅድመ፡ ልዑል፡ ወይከሥት፡ [አፉሁ]፡ ወይስእል፡ ወይትጋነይ፡ እንበይነ፡ ኀጢአቱ።
verses.translation: He will give his heart to resort early to the Lord that made him, and will pray before the most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and make supplication for his sins.

translations.lxx: He will give his heart to resort early to the Lord that made him, and will pray before the most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and make supplication for his sins.
translations.ron: În pământul neamurilor străine va umbla, că el cântăreşte cele bune şi cele rele intre oameni.
translations.grk: Τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπιδώσει ὀρθρίσαι πρὸς Κύριον τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔναντι ὑψίστου δεηθήσεται· καὶ ἀνοίξει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐν προσευχῇ, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτοῦ δεηθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወእመሰ፡ ፈቀደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘዐቢይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወመልአ፡ ሎቱ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ጥበብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ያነቅዕ፡ ቃለ፡ ጥበቢሁ፡ [ለሊሁ]፡ ወበጸሎት፡ ይገኒ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: When the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences, and give thanks unto the Lord in his prayer.

translations.lxx: When the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences, and give thanks unto the Lord in his prayer.
translations.ron: Inima sa, de dimineaţă, o înalţă spre Domnul, Cel care l-a făcut pe el, şi înaintea Celui Preaînalt se va ruga.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν Κύριος ὁ μέγας θελήσῃ, πνεύματι συνέσεως ἐμπλησθήσεται· αὐτὸς ἀνομβρήσει ῥήματα σοφίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν προσευχῇ ἐξομολογήσεται Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ያረትዕ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምክረ፡ ወጥበበ፡ ወያኄልዮ፡ ዘኅቡእ፡ ያእምር።
verses.translation: He shall direct his counsel and knowledge, and on his secrets shall he meditate.

translations.lxx: He shall direct his counsel and knowledge, and on his secrets shall he meditate.
translations.ron: Va deschide gura sa întru rugăciune şi pentru păcatele sale se va ruga.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς κατευθύνει βουλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιστήμην, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀποκρύφοις αὐτοῦ διανοηθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ያርኢ፡ ጥበበ፡ ትምህርቱ፡ ወይትሜካሕ፡ በሕገ፡ ኪዳኑ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: He shall shew forth that which he hath learned, and shall glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.

translations.lxx: He shall shew forth that which he hath learned, and shall glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
translations.ron: De va vrea Domnul cel Mare, de duhul înţelegerii se va umple.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς ἐκφανεῖ παιδείαν διδασκαλίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν νόμῳ διαθήκης Κυρίου καυχήσεται.

verses.geez: ወብዙኃን፡ ይዌድስዎ፡ እንበይነ፡ ጥበቢሁ፡ ወኢይደመሰስ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወኢይጠፍእ፡ ዝክሩ፡ ወይቀውም፡ ስሙ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ።
verses.translation: Many shall commend his understanding; and so long as the world endureth, it shall not be blotted out; his memorial shall not depart away, and his name shall live from generation to generation.

translations.lxx: Many shall commend his understanding; and so long as the world endureth, it shall not be blotted out; his memorial shall not depart away, and his name shall live from generation to generation.
translations.ron: Atunci ca ploaia va vărsa cuvintele înţelepciunii sale şi în rugăciune se va mărturisi Domnului.
translations.grk: Αἰνέσουσι τὴν σύνεσιν αὐτοῦ πολλοὶ, ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐκ ἐξαλειφθήσεται· οὐκ ἀποστήσεται τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ζήσεται εἰς γενεὰς γενεῶν.

verses.geez: ወይትናገሩ፡ አሕዛብ፡ በጥበቢሁ፡ ወይዌድስዎ፡ በማእከለ፡ ማኅበር።
verses.translation: Nations shall shew forth his wisdom, and the congregation shall declare his praise.

translations.lxx: Nations shall shew forth his wisdom, and the congregation shall declare his praise.
translations.ron: El va îndrepta sfatul lui şi ştiinţa şi întru tainele Domnului va cugeta.
translations.grk: Τὴν σοφίαν αὐτοῦ διηγήσονται ἔθνη, καὶ τὸν ἔπαινον αὐτοῦ ἐξαγγελεῖ ἐκκλησία.

verses.geez: ወይኄይስ፡ ቀዊመ፡ ስሙ፡ እምነ፡ ፲፻፡ ወእምድኅረ፡ ሞተኒ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ግብሩ።
verses.translation: If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand: and if he live, he shall increase it.

translations.lxx: If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand: and if he live, he shall increase it.
translations.ron: El va arăta învăţătura dăscăliei sale şi în legea legăturii cu Domnul se va lăuda.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ἐμμείνῃ ὄνομα καταλείψει ἢ χίλιοι, καὶ ἐὰν ἀναπαύσηται ἐμποιεῖ αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ወዓዲ፡ እኄሊ፡ ወእነግር፤….።
verses.translation: Yet have I more to say, which I have thought upon; for I am filled as the moon at the full.

translations.lxx: Yet have I more to say, which I have thought upon; for I am filled as the moon at the full.
translations.ron: Lăuda-vor mulţi înţelepciunea lui; până în veac nu se va stinge.
translations.grk: Ἔτι διανοηθεὶς ἐκδιηγήσομαι, καὶ ὡς διχομηνία ἐπληρώθην.

verses.geez: ስምዑኒ፡ ውሉደ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወሥረጹ፡ ወከመ፡ ይጸጊ፡ ጽጌ፡ በውስተ፡ ጠለ፡ ገዳም፡ ጽገዩ።
verses.translation: Hearken unto me, ye holy children, and bud forth as a rose growing by the brook of the field:

translations.lxx: Hearken unto me, ye holy children, and bud forth as a rose growing by the brook of the field:
translations.ron: Nu va pieri pomenirea lui şi numele lui va fi viu în neamurile neamurilor.
translations.grk: Εἰσακούσετέ μου υἱοὶ ὅσιοι, καὶ βλαστήσατε ὡς ῥόδον φυόμενον ἐπὶ ῥεύματος ἀγροῦ·

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ መዐዛ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይጥዐም፡ መዐዛክሙ፡ ወአብቊሉ፡ ፍሬክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ ወአጥዕሙ፡ ወዐዛክሙ፡ ወሰብሑ፡ ማሕሌቶ፡ ወባርክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በኵሉ፡ ምግባሩ።
verses.translation: and give ye a sweet savour as frankincense, and flourish as a lily, send forth a smell, and sing a song of praise, bless the Lord in all his works.

translations.lxx: and give ye a sweet savour as frankincense, and flourish as a lily, send forth a smell, and sing a song of praise, bless the Lord in all his works.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea lui o va spune neamurile, şi lauda lui o va vesti adunarea.
translations.grk: καὶ ὡς λίβανος εὐωδιάσατε ὀσμὴν, καὶ ἀνθήσατε ἄνθος ὡς κρίνον· διάδοτε ὀσμὴν καὶ αἰνέσατε ᾆσμα· εὐλογήσατε Κύριον ἐπὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις.

verses.geez: ወአዕብይዎ፡ ለስሙ፡ ወግነዩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለስብሐቲሁ፡ በ፲፻ማሕሌት፡ ወበመሰንቆ፡ ወከመዝ፡ በሉ፡ ሶበ፡ ትሴብሕዎ።
verses.translation: Magnify his name, and shew forth his praise with the songs of your lips, and with harps, and in praising him ye shall say after this manner:

translations.lxx: Magnify his name, and shew forth his praise with the songs of your lips, and with harps, and in praising him ye shall say after this manner:
translations.ron: Cât va trăi, nume îşi va face mai mult decât o mie; şi când va muri, va spori mărirea lui.
translations.grk: Δότε τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ μεγαλωσύνην, καὶ ἐξομολογήσασθε ἐν αἰνέσει αὐτοῦ, ἐν ᾠδαῖς χειλέων καὶ ἐν κινύραις, καὶ οὕτως ἐρεῖτε ἐν ἐξομολογήσει,

verses.geez: ዐቢይ፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወፈድፋደ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ዘበዕድሜሁ።
verses.translation: All the works of the Lord are exceeding good, and whatsoever he commandeth shall be accomplished in due season.

translations.lxx: All the works of the Lord are exceeding good, and whatsoever he commandeth shall be accomplished in due season.
translations.ron: Încă cele ce le-am gândit le voi grăi şi ca luna plină sunt plin de înţelegere.
translations.grk: Τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου πάντα ὅτι καλὰ σφόδρα, καὶ πᾶν πρόσταγμα ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ ἔσται.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ከመ፡ ይበሉ፡ ለምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወለምንትኑ፡ ዝክቱ፡ ወኵሉ፡ በጊዜሁ፡ ይትፈቀድ፡ አቀሞ፡ ለማይ፡ ከመ፡ አረፍት፡ በቃሉ፤….።
verses.translation: For at time convenient they shall all be sought out: at his commandment the waters stood as an heap, and at the words of his mouth, the receptacles of waters.

translations.lxx: For at time convenient they shall all be sought out: at his commandment the waters stood as an heap, and at the words of his mouth, the receptacles of waters.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi-mă pe mine, fiii cei cuvioşi, şi odrăsliţi ca trandafirul ce creşte lângă curgerea apei.
translations.grk: Πάντα γὰρ ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ ζητηθήσεται· ἐν λόγῳ αὐτοῦ ἔστη ὡς θημωνία ὕδωρ, καὶ ἐν ῥήματι στόματος αὐτοῦ ἀποδοχεῖα ὑδάτων.

verses.geez: ወቅድሜሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ ግብረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ ተኀብኦ፡ እምውድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ።
verses.translation: The works of all flesh are before him, and nothing can be hid from his eyes.

translations.lxx: The works of all flesh are before him, and nothing can be hid from his eyes.
translations.ron: Daţi miros şi lăudaţi cu cântare, binecuvântaţi pe Domnul întru toate lucrurile.
translations.grk: Ἔργα πάσης σαρκὸς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι κρυβῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እምቅድመ፡ ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኵሎ፡ አእመረ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ምንትኒ፡ ነኪር፡ በቅድሜሁ።
verses.translation: He seeth from everlasting to everlasting; and there is nothing wonderful before him.

translations.lxx: He seeth from everlasting to everlasting; and there is nothing wonderful before him.
translations.ron: Daţi slavă numelui Lui şi vă mărturisiţi întru lauda Lui cu cântările buzelor şi cu alăute, şi aşa să ziceţi întru mărturisire:
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐπέβλεψε, καὶ οὐθέν ἐστι θαυμάσιον ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ ይበል፡ ለምንትኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወለምንትኑ፡ ዝክቱ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ መፍቅዶሙ፡ ተፈጥረ።
verses.translation: A man need not to say, What is this? wherefore is that? for he hath made all things for their uses.

translations.lxx: A man need not to say, What is this? wherefore is that? for he hath made all things for their uses.
translations.ron: Lucrurile Domnului toate sunt foarte bune şi toată porunca la vremea sa va fi împlinită.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔστιν εἰπεῖν, τί τοῦτο; εἰς τί τοῦτο; πάντα γὰρ εἰς χρείας αὐτῶν ἔκτισται.

verses.geez: ወበረከቱኒ፡ ከመ፡ ማየ፡ ተከዜ፡ መልአት፡ ወከመ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ [አርወየታ፡]ለምድር።
verses.translation: His blessing covered the dry land as a river, and watered it as a flood.

translations.lxx: His blessing covered the dry land as a river, and watered it as a flood.
translations.ron: Şi nu este pentru ce să zici: Ce este aceasta? Că toate la vremea lor se dovedesc de folos.
translations.grk: Ἡ εὐλογία αὐτοῦ ὡς ποταμὸς ἐπεκάλυψε, καὶ ὡς κατακλυσμὸς ξηρὰν ἐμέθυσεν.

verses.geez: ወከማሁ፡ መዐቱኒ፡ ከፈለቶሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ።
verses.translation: As he hath turned the waters into saltness: so shall the heathen inherit his wrath.

translations.lxx: As he hath turned the waters into saltness: so shall the heathen inherit his wrath.
translations.ron: Prin cuvântul Lui a stat apa ca stogul, şi prin graiul gurii Lui adunările apelor.
translations.grk: Οὕτως ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ ἔθνη κληρονομήσει, ὡς μετέστρεψεν ὕδατα εἰς ἅλμην.

verses.geez: ርቱዕ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ ወለኃጥእሰ፡ ዕቅፍት፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘሜጦ፡ ለማይ፡ ወረሰዮ፡ ጼወ።
verses.translation: As his ways are plain unto the holy; so are they stumbling-blocks unto the wicked.

translations.lxx: As his ways are plain unto the holy; so are they stumbling-blocks unto the wicked.
translations.ron: Întru porunca Lui toată bunăvoinţa este şi nu este cine să împuţineze izbăvirea pe care o dăruieşte.
translations.grk: Αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ τοῖς ὁσίοις εὐθεῖαι, οὕτως τοῖς ἀνόμοις προσκόμματα.

verses.geez: ሠናይት፡ ለሠናያት፡ ተፈጥረት፡ እምትካት፡ ወከማሁ፡ እኪትኒ፡ ለኃጥኣን።
verses.translation: For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.

translations.lxx: For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.
translations.ron: Toate faptele oamenilor sunt de faţă înaintea Lui şi nimic nu se poate ascunde de la ochii Lui. Din veac în veac a privit şi nimic nu este străin înaintea Lui.
translations.grk: Ἀγαθὰ τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς ἔκτισται ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, οὕτως τοῖς ἁμαρτωλοῖς κακά.

verses.geez: ቀዳሜ፡ ኵሉ፡ መፍቅዱ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ማይ፡ ወእሳት፡ ወኀጺን፡ ወጼው፡ ወእክል፡ ሥርናይ፡ ወመዓር፡ ወሐሊብ፡ ደመ፡ አስካል፡ ወቅብእ፡ ወልብስ።
verses.translation: The principal things for the whole use of man's life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.

translations.lxx: The principal things for the whole use of man's life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.
translations.ron: Nu pot zice: Ce este aceasta? Pentru ce este aceasta? Căci toate sunt făcute cu un scop.
translations.grk: Ἀρχὴ πάσης χρείας εἰς ζωὴν ἀνθρώπου, ὕδωρ, πῦρ, καὶ σίδηρος, καὶ ἅλα, καὶ σεμίδαλις πυροῦ, καὶ μέλι, καὶ γάλα, αἷμα σταφυλῆς, καὶ ἔλαιον, καὶ ἱμάτιον.

verses.geez: ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ በረከቶሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወከማሁ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ይትመየጦሙ፡ በእኩይ።
verses.translation: All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.

translations.lxx: All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.
translations.ron: Binecuvântarea Lui a acoperit pământul ca un râu şi ca un potop a adăpat uscatul.
translations.grk: Ταῦτα πάντα τοῖς εὐσεβέσιν εἰς ἀγαθὰ, οὕτως τοῖς ἁμαρτωλοῖς τραπήσεται εἰς κακά.

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ መንፈስ፡ ለተበቅሎ፡ ተፈጥረት፡ ወበመንሱቶሙ፡ ያዐብይዋ፡ ለመቅሠፍቶሙ፡ ወበዕድሜሆሙ፡ ይዘረው፡ ኀይሎሙ፡ ወመቅሠፍተ፡ ፈጣሪሆሙ፡ ይቀርቦሙ።
verses.translation: There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.

translations.lxx: There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.
translations.ron: Aşa mânia Lui o vor moşteni neamurile, precum a făcut apele dulci în sărătură.
translations.grk: Ἔστι πνεύματα ἃ εἰς ἐκδίκησιν ἔκτισται, καὶ ἐν θυμῷ αὐτῶν ἐστερέωσαν μάστιγας αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐν καιρῷ συντελείας ἰσχὺν ἐκχέουσι, καὶ τὸν θυμὸν τοῦ ποιήσαντος αὐτοὺς κοπάσουσι.

verses.geez: እሳት፡ ወበረድ፡ ወረኃብ፡ ወብድብድ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ለተበቅሎ፡ ተፈጥረ።
verses.translation: Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance;

translations.lxx: Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance;
translations.ron: Căile Lui, pentru cei cuvioşi, sunt drepte, iar pentru cei fără de lege sunt pline de piedici.
translations.grk: Πῦρ καὶ χάλαζα καὶ λιμὸς καὶ θάνατος, πάντα ταῦτα εἰς ἐκδίκησιν ἔκτισται.

verses.geez: ስነነ፡ አራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ ወዐቃርብት፡ ወአፍዖት፡ ወኲናት፡ ከመ፡ ትሠርዎሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን።
verses.translation: teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword, punishing the wicked to destruction,

translations.lxx: teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword, punishing the wicked to destruction,
translations.ron: Din început cele bune s-au zidit, iar pentru cei păcătoşi, cele rele.
translations.grk: Θηρίων ὁδόντες καὶ σκορπίοι καὶ ἔχεις καὶ ῥομφαία ἐκδικοῦσα εἰς ὄλεθρον ἀσεβεῖς,

verses.geez: ወውእቱሰ፡[ያስተፌሥሕ፡]በሣህሉ፡ ወያስተዴሉ፡ ለዓለም፡ መፍቅደ፡ ወኵሉ፡ እምከመ፡ በጽሐ፡ ዕድሜሁ፡ ወኮነ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ የኀልቅ፡ ሶቤ[ሃ]።
verses.translation: shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not go beyond his word.

translations.lxx: shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not go beyond his word.
translations.ron: Începutul a toată trebuinţa vieţii omului este: apa, focul şi fierul, sarea şi făina de grâu, mierea şi laptele, sângele strugurelui, untdelemnul şi haina.
translations.grk: ἐν τῇ ἐντολῇ αὐτοῦ εὐφρανθήσονται, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἰς χρείας ἑτοιμασθήσονται, καὶ ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν οὐ παραβήσονται λόγον.

verses.geez: እንበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ እምፍጥረቱ፡ ተሠርዐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወኀለይክዎ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ወለካእክዎ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ።
verses.translation: Therefore from the beginning I was resolved, and thought upon these things, and have left them in writing.

translations.lxx: Therefore from the beginning I was resolved, and thought upon these things, and have left them in writing.
translations.ron: Acestea toate celor cuvioşi întru bunătăţi vor fi; iar celor păcătoşi întru cele rele se vor întoarce.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξ ἀρχῆς ἐστηρίχθην, καὶ διενοήθην, καὶ ἐν γραφῇ ἀφῆκα.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ሠናይ፡ ወይሁብ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ኵሉ፡ መፍቅዶ፡ በበጊዜሁ።
verses.translation: All the works of the Lord are good: and he will give every needful thing in due season.

translations.lxx: All the works of the Lord are good: and he will give every needful thing in due season.
translations.ron: Sunt vânturi făcute ca să aducă pedeapsă şi întru urgia lor au întărit bătăile lor.
translations.grk: Τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου πάντα ἀγαθὰ, καὶ πᾶσαν χρείαν ἐν ὥρᾳ αὐτῆς χορηγήσει.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይብሎ፡ ዘንተሰ፡ እኩየ፡ ፈጠርከ፡ ወዝክተሰ፡ አሠነይከ፡ እስመ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዕለቱ፡[ይንእዶ]።
verses.translation: So that a man cannot say, This is worse than that: for in time they shall all be well approved.

translations.lxx: So that a man cannot say, This is worse than that: for in time they shall all be well approved.
translations.ron: Şi în vremea săvârşirii vor vărsa urgia şi mânia Celui care le-a făcut o vor linişti.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν εἰπεῖν, τοῦτο τούτου πονηρότερον, πάντα γὰρ ἐν καιρῷ εὐδοκιμηθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ በኵሉ፡ ልብክሙ፡ ወበአፉክሙ፡ ሰብሕዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወባርኩ፡ ለስሙ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ።
verses.translation: And therefore praise ye the Lord with the whole heart and mouth, and bless the name of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And therefore praise ye the Lord with the whole heart and mouth, and bless the name of the Lord.
translations.ron: Focul şi grindina, foametea şi moartea, toate acestea spre pedepsire sunt făcute.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν ἐν πάσῃ καρδίᾳ καὶ στόματι ὑμνήσατε, καὶ εὐλογήσατε τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου.
